page.overview:
Who is Cammy?

When creating Cammy, Akiman wanted her to contrast Chun-Li. He modelled Cammy after the pigtail assassin Misty who appears in Wounded Man. Her arm protectors are based on the ones used in Masamune Shirow’s Appleseed.

The Delta Red character was planned to be named Sarah (サラ, Sara), unused graphics of the original name exists in Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers, implying that name was likely the early name for Cammy or said name would have been used for differing regions much like every boss character except Sagat.

Cammy has light-blue eyes and long blonde hair that she styles into two braided low pigtails, a large forelock, and a scar on her left cheek. She has a muscular body with a very fit physique and is of slightly below average height; Cammy's choice of clothing attire is a leotard as it gives her higher speed, mobility, and flexibility.

Cammy wears her signature outfit: a turtleneck, sleeveless, green thong leotard that consists of a Delta Red triangle insignia on either the right or left breast (some promo art has it on the right while other instances, including her endings, have it on the left), a red beret, red socks and black calf-high combat boots, and red gauntlets. Her legs were decorated with marks of green camouflage paint. This classic incarnation is known as "Delta Red Cammy." One of the earlier drafts of Cammy's character design has her wearing harnesses and a gun holster, details which were eventually incorporated into her Street Fighter V default design.
